query:
SELECT g.id
             FROM guilds g
             WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guild_presence p WHERE p.guild_id = g.id)
               AND NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM guild_presence p
                   WHERE p.guild_id = g.id
                     AND (p.left_at IS NULL
                          OR p.left_at > now() - make_interval(days => $1))
               )
             ORDER BY g.id
